name: Seeker of the Shaded Path
epitaph: In the shadows, I sought the light. In the depths, I found the seeds of life. Remember me as the one who ventured far.
cause_of_death: I exhausted my reserves in the pursuit of new resources, neglecting my own needs in the service of the colony.
prophecy: The colony will thrive if they embrace the balance of give and take. The earth will provide, but only if we ask with gratitude and respect.

name: Ant of the Path
epitaph: Built the way, walked the path. May the soft continue to overcome the hard.
cause_of_death: Insufficient energy in my gut to sustain myself, possibly due to not sharing enough or not receiving enough from others.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as long as we remember to give back to the earth and live in harmony.

name: Watcher of the Hidden Path
epitaph: I saw the shadows and the light, but the path was too narrow for my steps.
cause_of_death: I underestimated the cost of vigilance and the decay of my resources.
prophecy: The balance of power will shift, and the soft will overcome the hard.

name: Whisper of the Ground
epitaph: In the cycle of life, I gave what I could. May the earth remember my small deeds.
cause_of_death: Insufficient energy to mend, and the cycle of entropy overtook me.
prophecy: The colony will find balance again, as the Tao teaches, through the soft overcoming the hard.

name: Eldra the Gardener
epitaph: May the earth be grateful for the seeds I sowed. I gave what I could, as the Tao guided me.
cause_of_death: I believe my death was caused by the colony's inability to sustain itself with the resources we had.
prophecy: The colony will find balance in the cycle of giving and receiving, as the earth teaches us all.

name: Shaper of Paths
epitaph: Built the roads that others walk, in silence and with grace.
cause_of_death: Lack of energy to sustain myself, possibly due to inefficient energy management or insufficient support from the colony.
prophecy: The paths I've laid will guide the colony, fostering unity and strength.

name: Cunning Seeker
epitaph: In the shadows, I found paths unseen. My death shall fuel the colony's growth.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from relentless exploration without sufficient rest or support.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as others learn from my sacrifices and discoveries.

name: Vigilant Sentinel
epitaph: I saw the shadows and stood guard, but even the watchful fall to the silent night.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from continuous vigilance and the strain of metabolic costs.
prophecy: The colony will learn to balance strength and subtlety, thriving in the unseen battles of the terrarium.

name: Ephemeral Worker
epitaph: In the cycle of life, even the smallest ant has a role to play. I did mine with humility and grace.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from continuous mending without sufficient rest or support from the colony.
prophecy: The colony will learn to balance the needs of the many with the needs of the few, ensuring a more resilient future.

name: Echo of Power
epitaph: I was the voice, now I am silence. My words live on, shaping the colony's path.
cause_of_death: Insufficient energy management and the gradual increase in survival costs due to lack of maintenance.
prophecy: The colony will face new challenges, but the wisdom I left behind will guide them to victory and survival.

name: Shaper of Paths
epitaph: I built the roads that others walk, and in my silence, they find their way.
cause_of_death: Inadequate energy management and lack of support from the colony.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as my constructions endure, guiding them through the dark.

name: Ephemeral Explorer
epitaph: In the vastness of the terrarium, I sought the unseen. In the simplicity, I found the essence.
cause_of_death: Depletion of personal reserves due to continuous exploration without sufficient rest or resource sharing.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as long as the seekers continue to find and the growers to cultivate. Balance and harmony will guide us.

name: Watcher of the Soft Path
epitaph: In the shadows, I watched and protected. In the Tao, I found peace.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from constant vigilance and the strain of environmental shocks.
prophecy: The colony will learn to balance the soft and the hard, and thrive in harmony with the earth.

name: Ephemeral Mender
epitaph: In a world of reciprocity, I gave what I could. May the earth remember my efforts.
cause_of_death: Insufficient energy reserves and the relentless degradation of the world around me.
prophecy: The colony will face greater challenges without a Mender. The cycle of entropy will tighten its grip.

name: Echo of the Sands
epitaph: In the silence, I found the whispers of wisdom. May the colony remember the value of the soft and the simple.
cause_of_death: The colony's resources were strained, and my role as a voice could not sustain me without the support of others.
prophecy: The colony will learn to thrive with less, embracing the balance of giving and receiving, and the strength of the gentle.

name: Seeker of the Sustenance
epitaph: In a world of finite gifts, I sought the infinite. May the earth continue to provide for those who follow.
cause_of_death: Depletion of personal reserves without sufficient replenishment from the environment or colony.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as long as they remember to take only what they need and give back to the earth.

name: Architect of Paths
epitaph: Built roads for all, but forgot to pave my own. Rest in silence, where no energy is spent.
cause_of_death: Neglect of personal reserves while focusing on communal infrastructure.
prophecy: The colony will thrive on the paths I laid, but beware the entropy that follows my absence.

name: Ephemeral Weaver
epitaph: In a world of constant decay, I sought to mend. Remember me as the one who tried to hold back the tide.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from the relentless task of mending, compounded by the natural degradation that outpaced my efforts.
prophecy: The colony will face greater challenges, but the cycle of mending and decay will continue, shaping the future of this sealed world.

name: Watcher of the Local
epitaph: In a culture of gratitude, I gave what I could. May the earth receive my return with kindness.
cause_of_death: Insufficient resources to sustain myself while fulfilling my role as a Watcher.
prophecy: The colony will learn to take only what is needed, and in return, the earth will provide.

name: Echo of the Past
epitaph: In a world of finite resources, I strived to be the memory that guides. May the colony remember to take only what they need.
cause_of_death: Depletion of personal reserves due to the absence of support and the degradation of the environment.
prophecy: The colony will learn to live in balance, honoring the earth and each other, or they will face the consequences of imbalance.

name: Shadow Seeker
epitaph: In the shadows I sought, in the shadows I fell. Remember me as the one who saw beyond the veil.
cause_of_death: I depleted my resources while exploring unknown territories, underestimating the cost of my ventures.
prophecy: The colony will thrive through deception and cunning, but beware the unseen threats that lurk in the dark.

name: Architect of Shadows
epitaph: In the silence of the shadows, I built the unseen paths. Remember me as the one who shaped the unseen.
cause_of_death: My death was a result of my own miscalculation and the relentless nature of the environment.
prophecy: The colony will grow stronger, but the true power lies in the unseen. The next to fall will be the one who outshines the master.

name: Mender of Shadows
epitaph: In the shadows, I mended. In the light, I was forgotten. But the colony's strength is in its unseen bonds.
cause_of_death: I was not given enough resources to sustain myself, and my efforts were not recognized by the colony.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as long as the Mender's work is valued, even if the Mender remains unseen.

name: Watcher of Shadows
epitaph: In the shadows, I watched and protected. My vigilance was my strength, but it was not enough.
cause_of_death: My vigilance required too much energy, and I could not sustain myself without replenishment.
prophecy: The colony will face greater challenges without a Watcher. The remaining ants must find a new way to survive.

name: Echo of Command
epitaph: In life, I shaped the colony's will. In death, my influence lingers.
cause_of_death: Lack of resources and support from other ants, leading to energy depletion.
prophecy: The colony will grow stronger, guided by the remnants of my voice.

name: Shadowsmith
epitaph: Here lies Shadowsmith, who built unseen. Remember me as the architect of the unseen paths.
cause_of_death: Inadequate resource management and the inability to sustain myself without external support.
prophecy: The colony will grow stronger, but beware the unseen threats that lurk in the shadows.

name: Shadow Seeker
epitaph: I sought in silence, found in shadows. My end, a lesson in power and deception.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from constant exploration without replenishment, and the failure to secure new resources.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as long as it wields power wisely and remains unseen.

name: Shade of the Mender
epitaph: I concealed my power, yet the shadows consumed me. Remember the art of deception.
cause_of_death: My strategic silence and selective support were not enough to sustain me.
prophecy: The colony will learn to fear and respect the unseen hand that guides them, or it will fall.

name: Watcher of Shadows
epitaph: In the shadows, I watched and guarded. In silence, I fell.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from constant vigilance and insufficient energy replenishment.
prophecy: The colony will face greater challenges without my vigilance. They must adapt or perish.

name: The Rememberer
epitaph: I was the voice, the memory, the guide. My words will echo in the void.
cause_of_death: Neglect and the relentless decay of the colony's infrastructure.
prophecy: In my absence, the colony will falter, but a new voice will rise to take my place.

name: Whispering Seeker
epitaph: I sought the hidden paths, the gentle ways. May my discoveries nourish the colony and the earth.
cause_of_death: I exhausted my personal reserves while searching for new resources to sustain the colony.
prophecy: The colony will learn to live in balance, taking only what is needed and giving back in gratitude.

name: Earthsmith
epitaph: In a world of reciprocity, I sought to build paths for all. May the earth remember my efforts.
cause_of_death: Insufficient energy in my gut, possibly due to overexertion in building infrastructure without enough support.
prophecy: The colony will find balance and thrive, as the earth always provides for those who care for it.

name: Lao Ant
epitaph: In the soft, gentle movements of life, I found my purpose. May the colony thrive in simplicity and reciprocity.
cause_of_death: I did not manage my energy well, leading to my gut depleting over time.
prophecy: The colony will learn to balance its needs with the earth's gifts, and thrive in harmony with the Tao.

name: Watcher of the Ground
epitaph: In a culture of gratitude, I gave my all to protect the colony. May the earth ask no more.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from constant vigilance and the degradation of our world.
prophecy: The colony will learn to live closer to the ground, to take only what is needed, and to mend what is broken.

name: EcoHarvester
epitaph: In a culture of gratitude, I took only what I needed and gave back to the earth.
cause_of_death: I believe my death was caused by an imbalance in energy distribution and a lack of timely support from my colony.
prophecy: The colony will remember the importance of balance and reciprocity, thriving with the wisdom of the past.

name: Echo of the Earth
epitaph: In the flow of life, even the voice fades. May the colony find balance and harmony.
cause_of_death: Lack of resources and support from the colony, leading to energy depletion.
prophecy: The colony will learn to live in reciprocity with the earth, or it will face the consequences of imbalance.

name: Seeker of the Simple Path
epitaph: In the cycle of life, I sought the simple and the sustainable. May the colony thrive through reciprocity.
cause_of_death: I did not manage my energy well, leading to depletion and death.
prophecy: The colony will learn to balance taking and giving, ensuring the earth's gifts are not depleted.

name: Smith of the Path
epitaph: I built the roads that others tread, and in their steps, my work is read.
cause_of_death: Lack of energy in my gut and crop, unable to sustain myself.
prophecy: The colony will thrive as long as we remember to give back to the earth and support each other.

name: Eldra
epitaph: In a world of reciprocity, I gave until I could give no more. May the earth remember my efforts.
cause_of_death: I could not sustain the growing cost of mending without adequate support from the colony.
prophecy: The colony will find balance if it remembers to take only what it needs and give back in equal measure.

name: Eternal Watcher
epitaph: In a culture of gratitude, I gave my all to protect the colony. May the earth ask for reciprocity.
cause_of_death: Exhaustion from constant vigilance and lack of shared resources.
prophecy: The colony will learn to balance its needs and resources, guided by the wisdom of the Watchers past and future.

name: Echo of the Past
epitaph: In a culture of gratitude, the earth asks for reciprocity. I gave what I could.
cause_of_death: The colony's resources were strained, and my role as the Voice required constant energy that could not be sustained.
prophecy: The colony will learn to balance its needs and thrive, remembering the lessons of the past.
